product_updates.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
product_updates.content: In the HBS Foundry program, AI avatars provide feedback during practice pitches and board meetings.

product_updates.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
product_updates.content: Built by DeepMind alumni, British AI lab Inherent released Faraday, an AI agent whose ability to replicate scientific papers could be a stepping stone for innovation.

product_updates.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
product_updates.content: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen SB 53, an AI safety bill that the company previously opposed.

product_updates.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
product_updates.content: A new study finds leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models, raising questions about preparedness as AI systems increasingly demonstrate unexpected and potentially dangerous behavior.
